messages.subject: error in loading data
parts:
Sir,

I am trying to do population genetic analysis using poppr. My sample contains mixed ploidy got some diploid and some triploid like the pinf example (https://grunwaldlab.github.io/Population_Genetics_in_R/Data_Preparation.html#polyploids). So I scored as pinf example and run the code getting error.
could you please help me to solve this. I searched in google groups using recode will solve problem but in that also getting error. Please let me know what am doing wrong to solve this initial error.

Thank you

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] error in loading data
parts:
Hello,

There are a couple of issues here that the error message is trying to help with:

1. You need to set the ploidy flag in read.genalex() to the maximum ploidy. You mention that you have some diploid and some triploid individuals, but you've coded your data as tetraploid (4 columns per locus):

mydata <- read.genalex("mydata.csv", ploidy = 4)

(If you decide to remove those extra zero columns, you should then set ploidy = 3)

2. Cell C1 contains the number 2. Unless you specify the exact population sizes in the next two cells, you should set cell C1 to 1 (this is documented in https://grunwaldlab.github.io/Population_Genetics_in_R/Data_Preparation.html#basic-format)

Hope that helps,

Zhian
